author: fable-cursor
criterion: Ground at viewpoint E shows soil/moss/grass transitions with fine roughness like the reference plaza edges.
note: At E the ground transition is grass -> a flat orange soil band -> slab, a two-tone hard edge along the whole left verge (x 0.0-0.55, y 0.58-1.0): no moss halo, no soil roughness, no shade, the verge itself a uniform pale hay carpet. At the house base the ground is a green mound with a pile of identical grey pebbles. The reference shows dark shaded soil, grass tufts, broadleaf weeds and moss grading into the stone edges with fine roughness. Layers/detailNormal pass the gate; the visual transition does not.
